title: Time-to-Antimicrobials Survival Curve in Septic Shock
author: Ian Furst
caption: Graph illustrating decreasing survival probability with delayed initiation of effective antimicrobial therapy in septic shock.
alt_text: Line chart plotting survival percentage against hours of delay before effective antimicrobial administration in septic shock.
clinical_relevance: Highlights the time-critical nature of sepsis diagnosis and broad-spectrum antimicrobial treatment in resource-limited spaceflight environments (CLIFF-044, p.5-7).
